Python Standard Library
By Fredrik Lundh
 
 
Publisher
: O'Reilly
Pub Date : May 2001
ISBN
: 0-596-00096-0
Pages
: 300
Python Standard Library, an essential guide for serious Python programmers, delivers accurate, author-tested
documentation of all the modules in the Python Standard Library, along with over 300 annotated example scripts
using the modules. This version of the book covers all the new modules and related information for Python 2.0, the
first major release of Python in four years.
